name: Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Warwick

questions.label: Intro

editingBrief: CLIENT TESTIMONIAL for Gracie Jiu-Jitsu Warwick. Produce (1) a full-length testimonial from the whole take, and (2) one standalone clip per segment. segment.question is the context; the answer is the usable soundbite. Best clips for ads: HES (objection-buster), RESULT (transformation), RECO (recommendation), ONE (one-liner). Trim dead air at each segment's start/end, add burned-in captions, keep the speaker centered, and export one file per platform per segment using platformTargets (IG/TikTok/FB/LinkedIn).
